items.title: This portfolio
items.summary: A personal brand site shaped around blueprint logic, document trust, and a restrained editorial aesthetic.
body: This site was designed as a working portfolio case study: it carries the same principles I use in visa support and design work — clarity, trust, and deliberate structure.
The visual system mixes engineering drafting cues with travel-document details, so the result feels composed rather than generic.
